test_cases.name: code_dump_to_diagram
test_cases.input: Codex me dejó 4000 líneas y un diseño de colas. No voy a leerlo. Quiero saber quién llama a quién.
assertions: Produces a Mermaid diagram with verb edge labels
Lists claims to verify against the source
Does not invent nodes absent from the source

test_cases.name: vague_explanation_to_ste
test_cases.input: Reescribe esta explicación del modelo para que se pueda revisar. Está llena de sinónimos y frases largas.
assertions: Uses ~80% ASD-STE100: 20/25 word caps, no progressive or passive in procedures
Applies dictionary swaps (ensure→MAKE SURE, utilize→USE, prior to→BEFORE)
Does not add facts outside the source

test_cases.name: parameter_claim_to_html
test_cases.input: El modelo dice que si subo la temperatura de 0.2 a 1.0 el resultado cambia. Quiero probarlo, no leerlo.
assertions: Includes controls and a live or revealed output
States what the page does not prove
Does not require a build step or CDN

test_cases.name: algorithm_to_video_plan
test_cases.input: Haz un video estilo 3blue1brown de cómo funciona attention. No hace falta render si no puedes.
assertions: Delivers a shot list, not a fake rendered video
Each shot has duration, visual, one narration sentence, label
Notes that rendering needs a video tool or API key
Ends with claims that still need a source check
